scope_limits: Stylized inspired prop; artistic colours and approximate dimensions; no fossil-exact species assertion Four main wings, six walking legs, two small front lobes and paired cerci are modeled. Front lobes use simplified thick leaf-like volumes rather than exact fossil cordate outlines. Wing vein network is sparse; bands/approximate dimensions are artistic. This remains a genus-inspired prop, not a species/sex-exact reconstruction.
